prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent MID ground plane for the existing 2D fighting game Digital Circus — Encore, stage softballfield.
Primary request: create only the near portion of the softball field, as a single wide 16:9 transparent PNG ground overlay. This is the middle plane matching reference image 1 exactly in palette, frontal camera, material style and illumination. Use the same native wide canvas proportions (1672 x 941 reference, 16:9 landscape); do not crop to the visible ground.
Input images: image 1 is the accepted FAR stadium plane, used for alignment and lighting only; do NOT include its stands, sky, fence or lights in this new image. Image 2 is the official nine-cell episode reference sheet; the middle-right and lower-right cells provide the green grass and ochre earth material references. Ignore all characters and lettering.
Subject: a low continuous foreground part of the softball field. A narrow band of short green grass transitions into a broad smooth warm ochre packed-earth infield running horizontally across the whole canvas. Fine subtle earth texture, no rocks or objects. Keep the central fighting strip very flat and calm.
Composition: the entire upper 65% of the canvas is fully transparent empty space. The top edge of the field begins around 68–71% image height as a low soft grass edge; the ochre earth starts around 74% and fills the remaining bottom area to the bottom edge. A fighter's feet will sit at 79% image height, on the clear flat earth. The field extends naturally through both side edges for horizontal camera movement, no isolated mound, no vignette or cutout outline. A slight distant curve in the grass boundary is acceptable, but the playable ground has no steps or perspective tilt. Full-scene 16:9 positioning must be kept.
Style/medium: clean whimsical 3D-painted ground, the same green and earthy tones and soft cool floodlight shading as image 1, moderate stylization, not photorealistic and not pixel art.
Constraints: native RGBA transparency above and around the ground; no painted transparency checkerboard, no opaque background, no stadium or sky, no front rail, no seats, no balls, no characters, no bats, no scoreboard, no logo, no text, no border, no white margins. Do not show or repeat the source stadium. This is ONLY one separate ground layer, not a full scene or a contact sheet.
nativeEditingPolicy: Preserve generated bytes; no retouch, resize or reencoding.
